invariants.rationale: Access to tmxFile is necessary for getDependencyFileHandles and must not be null.
textureParameter, if not null, should be of the expected parameter type for proper operation.
tmxFile should exist as getDependencyFileHandles will attempt to read from it.
tmxFile should be a file, not a directory, because it is typically a TMX file.
This loader expects a tmx file as the main input descriptor.
